ontology.name: go-basic
ontology.note: No immutable dated URL was verified (release.geneontology.org/2026-07-26/... returns 404); the canonical URL serves the current release, so reproducibility is pinned by this SHA-256 and any mismatch must fail loudly.

vocabulary.name: goslim_generic+GO:0005488
vocabulary.extension_justification: binding is the direct child of molecular_function that goslim_generic omits, while its sibling catalytic activity is included. Measured without it in a 400-protein sample: 296 annotation instances reached no slim ancestor (ATP binding alone in 77/400 proteins) and 22/400 proteins had no label at all; with it, 6 instances and 0/400 proteins.
vocabulary.excluded_justification: The aspect root is an ancestor of every Molecular Function term; with all-ancestor propagation it becomes a constant positive label. Excluded by rule, never by a training/evaluation mask.
vocabulary.documented_as: project extension of the official generic GO slim
